Alibaba is the go-to source for almost everything. We often say their products are cheaply made, but we rarely consider how these products are actually manufactured. Interestingly, many U.S. companies source their tools and materials from China to make the same products. This contradiction is amusing: we can’t have it both ways. Either Chinese products are poor quality, or they’re not. If they’re so bad, why do so many companies rely on Chinese tools and materials? If you look around your house, you’ll likely find over 100 items labeled ‘Made in China.’ This is more significant than many realize. There’s a reason no country would go to war with China. Apple didn’t manufacture its devices in China solely for cheap labor; it was for the skilled workforce. The level of skill China offers is something America simply can’t match, and that’s a fact.
